postings.title: Business Development Manager
postings.description:
About the Role
SuperAI is Asia’s largest AI event and one of the fastest-growing AI platforms globally, bringing together leading companies, founders, executives, investors and builders across artificial intelligence and frontier technologies.

We are hiring a Business Development Manager to join our commercial team. This is a revenue-focused role, responsible for identifying, pitching and closing sponsorship and partnership opportunities for SuperAI.

The ideal candidate has a proven track record in sales, an existing industry network across AI and technology, and a strong commercial drive. You should be highly organised, confident in front of clients, and comfortable building pipeline, managing senior relationships, and closing opportunities in a fast-moving environment where execution matters.

A strong interest in AI and frontier technology is important. Existing relationships across AI, enterprise technology, cloud, software, data, robotics, infrastructure or venture capital are a plus.

Responsibilities

- Identify and develop new sponsorship and partnership opportunities across AI and technology.

- Build and manage a pipeline of prospective sponsors and partners, from initial outreach through to close.

- Lead sales conversations with founders, executives, marketing teams and business leaders.

- Understand client objectives and align them with relevant sponsorship, exhibition, branding and activation opportunities.

- Manage existing sponsor relationships and identify opportunities for renewal and expansion.

- Work closely with marketing, operations, finance and legal to ensure successful execution of commercial partnerships.

- Stay close to industry trends, market developments and key companies across AI, enterprise technology, cloud, data, robotics and software.

- Take ownership of commercial targets and contribute directly to the growth of SuperAI.

Skills & Experience

- Proven track record in business development, sales, partnerships or sponsorship sales.

- Strong commercial instincts and ability to close.

- Excellent communication, presentation and negotiation skills.

- Highly organised, structured and able to manage multiple opportunities at once.

- High agency, ambitious, driven, accountable and comfortable working independently.

- Strong interest in AI and technology.

- Existing network across AI, enterprise technology, SaaS, cloud, data, robotics, infrastructure or venture capital is advantageous.

- Experience selling sponsorships, events, media, SaaS or B2B

postings.title: Content and Programming Lead
postings.description:
Role Overview

As the Content & Programming Lead for Super AI, you will be the mastermind behind the stage. You will own the intellectual blueprint of our flagship event, shaping the narrative of the world’s premier artificial intelligence gathering. From scouting world-class AI visionaries to meticulously crafting the daily agenda, you will ensure our programming is groundbreaking, cohesive, and deeply engaging.

If you are an obsessive organizer, a polished communicator, and have your finger on the pulse of the global AI ecosystem, this role is for you.

Key Responsibilities

- 

Agenda Architecture: Design, structure, and curate the master agenda for Super AI, balancing keynote speeches, panel discussions, fire-side chats, and technical workshops.

- 

Speaker Outreach & Recruitment: Identify, pitch, and secure high-caliber speakers, including AI researchers, tech executives, founders, policymakers, and cultural icons.

- 

End-to-End Speaker Coordination: Act as the primary point of contact for all confirmed speakers. Manage prep calls, collect presentation materials, coordinate logistics, and ensure a flawless VIP experience.

- 

Content Strategy & Curation: Research emerging AI trends (GenAI, robotics, AI ethics, compute infrastructure) to ensure the event's themes are cutting-edge and commercially relevant.

- 

Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with the marketing, operations, and production teams to ensure the event narrative aligns with promotional campaigns and on-stage execution.

What We Are Looking For

- 

Experience: 4+ years of experience in conference programming, content curation, or speaker management, preferably within the tech or AI conference space.

- 

Network & Industry Savvy: A deep understanding of the current AI landscape and an existing network (or the ability to quickly build one) within the tech ecosystem.

- 

Exceptional Communication: Top-tier written and verbal communication skills. You can write a cold pitch that a Fortune 500 CEO actually wants to reply to.

- 

Project Management Mastery: Ability to manage hundreds of moving parts, tight deadlines, and shifting schedules without breaking a sweat.

- 

Detail Obsession: A spreadsheet wizard who thrives on keeping speaker databases, schedules, and agendas flawlessly organized.

Why Join Super AI?

Shape the Future of AI Dialogue: You won't just be organizing an event; you will be curating the conversations that define where the global AI industry goes next.

- 

Global Impact: Work with a highly driven, international team putting together a world-class event.

- 

Unrivaled Networking: Rub shoulders with the absolute top tier of AI innovators, investors, and thought leaders.

- 

Dynamic Culture: A fast-paced, high-autonomy environment where your creative ideas for the stage actually get implemented.

postings.title: Content Marketing Manager
postings.description:
About The Role

As Content Marketing Manager, you will lead the development and execution of data-driven content strategies across digital platforms for our brands. Reporting to the Growth Marketing Lead, you will craft compelling narratives to elevate brand visibility, maximize social media impact, and drive lead generation initiatives.

This role serves as the guardian of both brands' voices, orchestrating diverse content streams while maintaining message consistency across all channels. Your responsibilities will span the entire content ecosystem–from crafting engaging social media campaigns and managing strategic content calendars to developing targeted email marketing initiatives and producing SEO-optimized long-form content.

Responsibilities

- Drive content strategy and execution across social media platforms (X/Twitter, Instagram, LinkedIn, TikTok), ensuring consistent brand voice and messaging

- Collaborate with the Marketing Lead to align content initiatives with overall marketing objectives and campaign goals.

- Create and manage comprehensive content calendars for multiple digital channels, adapting content format and style to each platform's unique requirements.

- Write compelling copy for social media posts, email campaigns, website content, and other marketing materials.

- Collaborate with cross-functional teams (Speakers, Sponsors, Business Analysts, Community) to support their objectives through strategic content initiatives and marketing channels.

- Monitor and analyze performance metrics across digital channels to optimize content strategy and improve engagement.

- Track and report on key performance indicators, providing regular insights and recommendations to improve content effectiveness.

- Conduct regular competitor analysis and stay current with industry trends in web3, AI, and FinTech spaces to inform content strategy.

- Stay current with digital marketing trends, best practices, and platform updates to maintain competitive advantage.

- Support content needs for marketing campaigns, ensuring timely delivery and brand consistency.

Requirements

- 3-5 years of experience in content marketing or similar role.

- Strong writing and editing skills with excellent attention to detail.

- Experience in developing and executing content strategies that drive engagement and lead generation, with a proven record of creating impactful content across social media platforms.

- Proficiency in social media analytics tools and performance tracking.

- Demonstrated ability to manage multiple projects and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.

- Strong collaboration skills and experience working with cross-functional teams.

- Critical thinking and problem-solving abilities, with a proactive approach to identifying opportunities and addressing challenges creatively.

- Self-motivated, with a strong sense of ownership and accountability

- Knowledge of the AI industry is a plus.

- Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communications, or related field.

postings.title: Content & Programming Lead
postings.description:
About The Role

SuperAI is hiring a Content and Programming Lead to own everything related to speakers, programming, and on-stage content across SuperAI. You will define what SuperAI stands for intellectually. This role reports directly to the founders, who has high autonomy and real decision-making power to influence SuperAI's long-term branding and positioning.

Responsibilities:

Speakers

- Define the speaker strategy for SuperAI

- Identify and recruit the most relevant AI founders, researchers, builders, and operators globally

- Filter signal vs noise in inbound speaker applications

- Proactively source the leaders of tomorrow - rising stars

- Manage speaker relationships end-to-end

- Ensure every speaker and session has a clear reason to exist

Content and Programming

- Define SuperAI’s annual content thesis and editorial direction

- Architect the full agenda (keynotes, panels, fireside chats, debates, demos, etc.)

- Craft sharp, opinionated session titles and formats

- Ruthlessly avoid generic, corporate, or “conference-slop” content

- Continuously raise the bar on quality, originality, and relevance

Understanding the AI Landscape

- Stay deeply plugged into the AI ecosystem (X/Twitter, open-source, research, startups)

- Track real debates: open vs closed, east vs west, agents, infra, scaling, regulation, economics

- Position SuperAI ahead of where the conversation is going - not behind it

Background & Requirements:

- Deeply interested in AI and use AI tools daily

- Active on X / Twitter and plugged into real AI discourse

- Comfortable forming strong opinions and defending them

- Intellectually curious, sharp, and allergic to fluff

- Confident reaching out cold and speaking directly to industry leading founders, researchers, and builders

- Experience at an AI startup, lab, or open-source project

- Background in research, engineering, or technical writing

- Experience curating content, communities, or media

- Previous founder or early-stage operator experience

Start Date: As soon as possible

Hybrid Work Arrangement - Welcome candidates in Hong Kong, Singapore, or other APAC countries.

postings.title: Creative Lead
postings.description:
About The Role

We are looking for a visionary Creative Lead to steer our brand's visual identity, narrative voice, and creative direction. You will bridge the gap between business strategy and compelling storytelling, turning big ideas into iconic campaigns across digital, video, print, and experiential mediums.

As the Creative Lead, you will direct a multidisciplinary team of designers, writers, and content creators, elevating the craft while ensuring every touchpoint resonates with our audience.

What You’ll Do

- 

Set the Creative Vision: Define, evolve, and safeguard the brand's visual and thematic identity across all channels and touchpoints.

- 

Lead & Direct: Pitch, conceptualize, and oversee high-impact creative campaigns from original brief to final execution.

- 

Manage & Mentor: Guide a talented team of copywriters, graphic designers, and multimedia producers, giving sharp creative direction and inspiring their best work.

- 

Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner closely with Marketing, Product, and Strategy teams to align creative output with core business objectives and target KPIs.

- 

Hands-on Craft: Jump into execution when needed—whether crafting key campaign visuals, directing video shoots, or sharpening brand copy.

- 

Trend & Quality Control: Maintain an uncompromising standard for quality while keeping a pulse on cultural trends, design shifts, and emerging tech.

What You Bring

- 

Proven Track Record: 5+ years of creative agency or in-house brand experience, with 2+ years leading creative teams or complex campaigns.

- 

Dynamic Portfolio: A robust showcase of multi-channel campaigns that demonstrate strong design fundamentals, story arcs, and conceptual thinking.

- 

Mastery of Tools: Expertise in Creative Cloud (Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign, Premiere/After Effects) and collaborative design software (Figma).

- 

Strategic Storytelling: Ability to translate abstract business goals and audience insights into intuitive, emotionally resonant creative concepts.

- 

Exceptional Communication: Articulate presenter who can pitch ideas convincingly to executive leadership and key stakeholders.

postings.title: Developer Relation Lead
postings.description:
About the Role

We are looking for a high-energy, community-first Developer Relations Lead who lives and breathes developer culture. In this role, you won't just be talking about our tech—you will be the bridge building a vibrant, global ecosystem around it.

Your primary superpower? Hackathons and relationships. You have a proven track record of designing, executing, and scaling high-impact hackathons (both virtual and IRL). More importantly, you possess an extensive, deep-rooted rolodex of software engineers, builders, and technical founders who trust your voice and love to build with you.

Key Responsibilities

- 

Own the Hackathon Strategy: End-to-end strategy, execution, and post-mortems for regional and global hackathons. You will turn raw sign-ups into shipped, high-quality projects.

- 

Cultivate the Engineer Network: Leverage and expand your existing vast network of developers, engineers, and technical architects to drive adoption of our platform.

- 

Champion the Developer Experience (DX): Act as the internal advocate for external developers. Gather brutal, honest feedback from hackathons and community interactions, and funnel it directly to our Product and Engineering teams.

- 

Technical Content & Education: Create highly engaging, frictionless onboarding materials—like quick-start repositories, boilerplate code, and technical tutorials—specifically optimized for fast-paced hackathon environments.

- 

Represent at Scale: Speak at major conferences, host workshops, judge hackathons, and maintain a highly visible, authentic presence in technical communities (GitHub, Discord, X/Twitter, Reddit).

What We Are Looking For

- 

The Hackathon Veteran: You have successfully organized or heavily participated in major hackathons (e.g., ETHGlobal, Major League Hacking, corporate mega-hackathons) and know exactly what it takes to keep developers engaged at 3:00 AM.

- 

The Connected Networker: You don't need to start building a network from scratch; you already have a massive web of relationships with engineers, open-source contributors, and tech communities.

- 

Technical Chops: You can code. While you aren't writing production software all day, you can confidently build sample apps, debug API integrations, and speak peer-to-peer with senior engineers.

- 

Exceptional Empathy: You genuinely care about developer success. You are patient, accessible, and obsessed with eliminating friction for builders.

- 

Event Master: Strong project management skills. You can coordinate logistics, marketing, tracking metrics, and prizing without breaking a sweat.

Requirements & Qualifications

- 

5+ years of experience in Developer Relations, Developer Evangelism, or Community Engineering.

- 

A strong portfolio of past technical events, hackathons, or community initiatives you personally spearheaded.

- 

Proficiency in at least one modern programming language (e.g., JavaScript/TypeScript, Python, Go, Rust) and familiarity with modern API architectures.

- 

Willingness to travel (up to 30-40%) to attend conferences, hackathons, and community meetups globally.

Bonus Points If You...

- 

Have a strong personal brand, technical blog, or large following in the developer ecosystem.

- 

Are a former software engineer who realized they love talking to humans just as much as writing code.

- 

Have deep experience in [insert specific niche, e.g., Web3 / AI / Cloud Infrastructure / Open Source].

What We Offer

- 

Competitive salary 

- 

Top-of-the-line tech setup of your choice.

- 

Flexible PTO and a hybrid working culture.

postings.title: Ecosystem Lead
postings.description:
Role Overview

As the Ecosystem Lead, you will be the ultimate super-connector at the intersection of Web3, blockchain, and Artificial Intelligence. You will own, scale, and nurture the global network of partners, projects, developers, and communities that form the bedrock of both TOKEN2049 and SuperAI.

This is a high-impact, strategic, and relationship-driven role. You will bridge the gap between emerging tech ecosystems and our flagship events, ensuring that the most innovative founders, high-value VCs, developer communities, and strategic partners are deeply integrated into our summits globally (Singapore, Dubai, and beyond).

Key Responsibilities

Ecosystem Growth & Relationship Management

- 

Cultivate Networks: Build and maintain deep relationships with top-tier Web3 projects, L1/L2 protocols, AI labs, foundational model developers, DAOs, and traditional enterprise tech giants.

- 

Side-Event Ecosystem Activation: Oversee and curate the massive web of independent side events, hackathons, and satellite meetups during event weeks (e.g., TOKEN2049 Week), ensuring high quality and seamless integration with the main event.

- 

Community Engagement: Engage with developer communities, research institutions, and university tech hubs to drive developer and talent attendance.

Strategic Partnerships & Value Creation

- 

VC & Investor Relations: Curate exclusive networking tracks, demo days, and matchmaking initiatives for Venture Capitals, Family Offices, and angel investors to meet portfolio companies.

- 

Co-Marketing Initiatives: Collaborate with ecosystem partners on joint marketing campaigns, community AMAs, and content drops to amplify event reach and brand authority.

- 

Feedback Loops: Act as the "eyes and ears" on the ground, gathering community feedback to help the production team shape themes, tracks, and speaker lineups that reflect current industry trends.

On-Site Experience & Execution

- 

Community Hubs: Design and oversee dedicated ecosystem zones on the exhibition floor (e.g., developer lounges, AI demo zones, hacker houses).

- 

VIP Facilitation: Act as a high-touch point of contact for ecosystem VIPs, foundation heads, and key community leaders during the events.

What We Are Looking For

- 

Experience: 7 years and above of experience in ecosystem growth, developer relations, community management, or strategic partnerships within the Web3/Crypto or AI/Deep Tech sectors.

- 

Deep Domain Knowledge: A strong understanding of the current crypto landscape (DeFi, DePIN, L2s, Infra) and AI landscape (LLMs, Agentic AI, decentralized AI). You don't need to be a developer, but you must speak their language fluently.

- 

The Rolodex: An existing network of founders, VCs, and community leaders in the global tech/crypto space.

- 

Event Savvy: Experience navigating, planning, or heavily participating in large-scale tech conferences, hackathons, or ecosystem weeks.

- 

Soft Skills: Exceptional communication, high emotional intelligence, and the ability to thrive in a fast-paced, high-pressure live event environment.

Why Join Us?

- 

The Epicenter of Tech: You will be at the absolute center of the global Web3 and AI industries, interacting daily with the innovators shaping the future.

- 

Autonomy: Freedom to build out ecosystem strategies from scratch with the backing of the industry’s most recognizable event brands.

postings.title: Head of AI
postings.description:
Role Overview

We are seeking a visionary and execution-focused Head of AI (Agentic Outreach) to spearhead the evolution of our growth, sales, and engagement marketing engines. In this role, you will design, build, and scale an ecosystem of autonomous AI agents capable of hyper-personalized, context-aware, and multi-channel outreach.

You will bridge the gap between advanced machine learning engineering and strategic business growth, moving beyond simple template automation to build dynamic, self-learning agentic workflows that orchestrate complex B2B/B2C communication strategies.

Key Responsibilities

1. Strategy & Architecture

- 

Vision & Roadmap: Define the strategic roadmap for agentic outreach, transitioning from static sequence automation to autonomous, goal-driven AI agent networks.

- 

System Architecture: Design and oversee the infrastructure for multi-agent systems that handle lead sourcing, intent signaling, content generation, and multi-turn conversational follow-ups.

- 

Guardrails & Ethics: Establish strict compliance, data privacy (GDPR/CCPA), brand voice alignment, and safety guardrails to ensure AI agents interact ethically and accurately.

2. Technical Execution & AI Engineering

- 

Agent Orchestration: Build and optimize workflows using framework stacks like LangChain, CrewAI, AutoGen, or custom-built internal orchestration layers.

- 

RAG & Memory Systems: Implement advanced Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) and persistent memory vector databases so agents maintain deep context across long-term buyer journeys.

- 

Model Optimization: Fine-tune, prompt-engineer, and select the optimal mix of proprietary (OpenAI, Anthropic) and open-source (Llama, Mistral) LLMs to balance cost, latency, and performance.

3. GTM Integration & Analytics

- 

Data Pipeline Integration: Connect agentic workflows seamlessly with our modern data stack, CRM (Salesforce/HubSpot), sales engagement tools, and data enrichment APIs (e.g., Clay, Apollo, ZoomInfo).

- 

Loop Optimization: Build reinforcement learning loops based on positive/negative conversion signals (e.g., booking a demo vs. "unsubscribe" requests) to continuously improve agent persuasion and timing.

- 

KPI Tracking: Own the performance metrics of AI-driven outreach, including pipeline generated, response quality scores, deliverability rates, and ROI.

Qualifications & Skills

Technical Requirements

- 

AI/ML Expertise: 5+ years and above of experience working with Large Language Models (LLMs), prompt engineering, and embeddings.

- 

Agentic Frameworks: Proven hands-on experience building autonomous agent architectures, multi-agent frameworks, and tool-use (function calling) loops.

- 

Programming Proficiency: Expert-level Python developer with experience in AI libraries and vector databases (Pinecone, Milvus, Qdrant, etc.).

- 

Data & API Integration: Deep understanding of web scraping, reverse APIs, webhook orchestration, and complex data enrichment pipelines.

Leadership & Strategic Skills

- 

Growth Mindset: Strong understanding of modern outbound B2B marketing, sales development (SDR/BDR) playbooks, and growth hacking principles.

- 

Team Building: Experience leading and mentoring cross-functional teams of AI engineers, data scientists, and growth marketers.

- 

Analytical Rigor: Strong statistical background to design and evaluate rigorous A/B testing frameworks for agentic variations.

Preferred Experience

- 

Experience in a fast-paced B2B SaaS environment or a high-growth tech startup.

- 

A portfolio of shipped AI products, open-source contributions to agentic frameworks, or public writing/research on the future of autonomous systems.

- 

Familiarity with sophisticated email deliverability infrastructure (domain warming, spintax, rotating IPs).

postings.title: Operations Manager
postings.description:
About The Role

As our Operations Manager, you will be responsible for managing the end-to-end event operations at SuperAI including but not limited to ticketing & payment, registration, exhibitors management, vendors management and on-site operations. You are also expected to roll out a world-class event operations roadmap to bring our events to be next level.

TOKEN2049 stands out in the global events calendar because we prioritise the attendee experience – we want every aspect of the event to be memorable and to convey attention to detail. You will be responsible for ensuring that everyone finds what they are looking for and remains engaged both digitally and in our in-person event.

Responsibilities

- Create and oversee a world-class event operations roadmap to bring SuperAI to the next level.

- Recruit, mentor and manage junior operations executives.

- Ticket management, including ticket sales, inventory management, and customer support.

- Oversee end-to-end event execution process, ensuring that all logistical elements are seamlessly coordinated.

- Develop and implement new systems to enhance the operations process.

- Manage the SuperAI online and on-site attendees registration before and during the event.

- Analyze event data and metrics to identify areas for improvement in operations and provide recommendations.

- Manage the Community Team, ensuring that both inbound and outbound inquiries are handled in a timely manner.

- Manage the SuperAI Help Desk - provide world class end-to-end customer service.

- Manage and coordinate with vendors to resolve any issues or changes during the event planning and execution phases.

- Manage the event staff, volunteers, and any subcontractors on-site.

- Troubleshoot and address any issues that arise during the event, making timely decisions to maintain the event's success.

Skills & Experience

- Entrepreneurial, detail-oriented, pragmatic, self-starter attitude.

- 10 years of experience with event operation/ tickets management for large-scale global events.

- Experience in planning and implementing new systems / initiatives to enhance operation process.

- Exceptional written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills.

- Attention to detail, critical thinking, problem solving, and the ability to work under pressure.

- Strong resilience and patience.

- Project management skills to juggle multiple projects and meet deadlines.

- Interest in and passion for AI space is a plus.

- Fluent in written and spoken English.

postings.title: Product Manager
postings.description:
About Us

We build the infrastructure where the world’s frontier technologies converge. TOKEN2049 is the world’s largest Web3 and crypto event ecosystem, hosting massive global flagships in Singapore and Dubai. SuperAI is the definitive gathering for the global Artificial Intelligence ecosystem, bringing together pioneers, sovereign compute giants, and builders shaping the intelligence explosion. 

We don't just view our platforms as once-a-year tech conferences; they are continuous, infrastructure-driven digital and physical networks. We are looking for an entrepreneurial Product Manager to own, scale, and innovate the digital experiences that connect over 50,000 global innovators annually. 

Role Overview

As the Product Manager for TOKEN2049 and SuperAI, you will bridge the gap between complex technical capabilities and high-end physical experiences. You will own the lifecycle of our web platforms, mobile networking applications, attendee badging systems, and AI-driven event tools (like real-time assistant agents and matchmaking algorithms). Your goal is to maximize connectivity, eliminate operational friction, and deliver an immersive, tech-forward product experience for partners, investors, and attendees.

Key Responsibilities

- 

Product Strategy & Roadmap: Define and drive the multi-platform product vision for both TOKEN2049 and SuperAI. Align digital tools with high-energy physical experiences like the NEXT Hackathons, Nexus Startup competitions, and AFTER 2049.

- 

Feature Delivery: Lead the end-to-end lifecycle of our digital products, from scoping and wireframing to engineering sprints, QA, and deployment. This includes custom web platforms, native mobile apps, and interactive attendee portals.

- 

AI Integration & Innovation: Actively build and scale AI-driven features for SuperAI and TOKEN2049, including AI-powered networking tools, automated attendee matchmaking, and conversational Telegram/in-app event assistants.

- 

Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner closely with Marketing, Commercial/Sponsorships, and Operations teams to translate business constraints and high-stakes deadlines into smooth technical execution.

- 

Data & Optimization: Track product metrics (user engagement, app adoption, connection success rates) to continuously iterate and eliminate "friction points" within the digital infrastructure.

What We’re Looking For

Experience & Qualifications

- 

3+ Years of Product Management Experience: Proven track record of launching and scaling consumer-facing web or mobile applications, preferably in fast-paced tech startups, B2B marketplaces, or event-tech ecosystems.

- 

Domain Familiarity: A solid understanding of Web3 concepts (wallets, token gating, NFTs) and Artificial Intelligence infrastructure (LLMs, AI agents, conversational UI).

- 

High Execution Velocity: Ability to manage tight, hard deadlines. In the events industry, launch dates cannot be pushed back; you must thrive under pressure and enjoy shipping features rapidly.

- 

Technical Literacy: Comfortable speaking the language of engineering. Experience working with APIs, content management systems, and custom mobile apps.

- 

User-Centric Design Focus: A sharp eye for UI/UX. You know how to design clean, high-end interfaces that appeal to C-level tech executives and elite developers alike.

Core Competencies

- 

The "Plumber" Mindset: A passion for building digital systems and workflows that reduce friction and connect people organically. 

- 

Extreme Ownership: You run toward problems, look for edge cases, and ensure everything from token-gated ticket portals to live agenda updates work flawlessly.

- 

Adaptability: Ready to switch contexts fluidly between the decentralized Web3 world of TOKEN2049 and the frontier-tech/compute landscape of SuperAI.

Benefits & Culture

- 

Front Row to the Future: Work at the literal center of the global tech ecosystem, interacting with leading founders, VCs, and innovators.

- 

High-Growth Environment: We operate with a lean, elite team. Your individual impact on our products will be visible to tens of thousands of users immediately.

- 

Global Exposure: Travel and on-site execution at our world-class venues and experiences (e.g., Marina Bay Sands).

- 

Competitive Compensation: Attractive salary, performance bonuses, and the tools you need to build at your best.

TOKEN2049 and SuperAI are equal opportunity employers. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

postings.title: Senior Graphic Designer
postings.description:
About The Role

We are seeking a Senior Graphic Designer to join our creative team. In this role, you will shape how TOKEN2049 and SuperAI look and feel to the world. You will design key marketing assets, all event collaterals, and motion content—translating the high-energy, premium feel of both brands into visuals that captivate tens of thousands of attendees, sponsors, and followers. You will own the regular cadence of creative updates across campaigns, ensuring our brands stay fresh, consistent, and impactful.

Responsibilities

- Own the Visual Identity: Lead the design of all marketing assets for both TOKEN2049 and SuperAI, including email campaigns, social media creatives, digital ads, and website banners. Ensure every visual touchpoint reflects the premium, high-energy nature of both flagship events.

- Drive Continuous Creative Evolution: Own the regular cadence of creative updates across campaigns, adapting visuals for different platforms and audiences while maintaining the distinct brand identities of TOKEN2049 and SuperAI.

- Bring Motion to Life: Create animated content for social media, event screens, and digital campaigns—think hype reels, countdown timers, speaker announcements, and sponsor sizzles that drive engagement for our next events in Dubai or Singapore.

- Design for Scale (IRL): Conceptualize and produce large-format designs for event production, including stage backdrops, venue signage, wayfinding systems, and printed collaterals that guide and wow thousands of attendees at both TOKEN2049 and SuperAI.

- Build Brand Cohesion: Work closely with the product and marketing teams to extend the TOKEN2049 and SuperAI brands across portal screens, app interfaces, and merchandise, ensuring a seamless visual language from screen to stage.

Qualifications

- 4–7 years of professional graphic design experience, ideally within events, lifestyle brands, tech, or creative agencies.

- A strong portfolio showcasing: marketing campaigns, social media creatives, large-format event signage, and motion graphics work for multiple brands or distinct product lines.

- Equal proficiency in Figma and Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign) —you move seamlessly between tools depending on the tas

- The Event Mindset: You understand that great event branding lives everywhere—from an Instagram story to a 20-meter stage backdrop. You are obsessed with how design shapes the attendee journey and builds hype for both TOKEN2049 and SuperAI.

- Brand Guideline Knowledge & Execution is a Must: You have deep experience working within established brand guidelines and executing them flawlessly across every touchpoint—from digital ads to large-format signage—ensuring consistency without compromising creativity. You are comfortable switching between the TOKEN2049 and SuperAI visual languages.

- Figma & Adobe Creative Suite Are Equally Important: You are equally proficient in Figma and the Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign). Whether collaborating with product designers on portal screens or crafting high-impact marketing assets, you move seamlessly between tools to deliver exceptional work.

- AI Generation is a Must: You actively use AI tools (such as Midjourney, DALLE, or Firefly) to accelerate ideation, generate custom visuals, and enhance creative workflows—knowing when to leverage AI and when to refine by hand.

- Motion Graphics Expertise: You are proficient in After Effects, Premiere Pro, or similar tools. You know how to bring static designs to life with motion that captures attention and tells a story.

- Speed & Scrappiness: We operate in a fast-paced environment with hard deadlines (event dates don't move!). You know how to balance "perfection" with "shipping on time" and can pivot quickly when priorities shift.

- Strong Typography & Layout Skills: You have a sharp eye for composition, hierarchy, and color. You must be able to work within the existing TOKEN2049 and SuperAI brand guidelines while pushing both brands forward across new formats and campaigns.

Nice to Haves

- Crypto & AI Curiosity: You don't need to be a trader or a data scientist, but you should be excited by Web3 culture, the future of finance, and the rapid evolution of artificial intelligence. Interest in both spaces will help you design better work for our audiences.

- 3D or Illustration Skills: Experience with Cinema 4D, Blender, or illustration tools to create custom assets and elevate campaign visuals.

- Print & Production Knowledge: Experience preparing files for large-format printing and understanding of materials, finishes, and on-site production requirements.

- Video Editing Skills: Ability to cut short-form video content for social media or event recaps.

- Experience working across time zones with distributed teams—you know how to stay aligned and communicate with clarity.

- A BFA or MFA in Graphic Design, Visual Communication, or a related design discipline.

postings.title: Talent Acquisition Specialist
postings.description:
About Us

We power the world’s most influential tech gatherings. TOKEN2049 is the flagship global event series where the web3 ecosystem converges to exchange ideas, network, and shape the industry. SuperAI is the premier platform gathering the brightest minds, enterprises, and builders in Artificial Intelligence. Together, our events bring together tens of thousands of attendees, top-tier speakers, and global media annually.

Position Overview

We are seeking a highly analytical, detail-oriented Marketing Data Specialist to bridge the gap between marketing strategy and data-driven execution. In this role, you will own the data ecosystem for both TOKEN2049 and SuperAI. You will analyze multi-channel campaign performance, optimize user acquisition funnels, manage audience segmentation, and build dashboards that provide actionable insights to maximize ticket sales, sponsorships, and global brand awareness.

Key Responsibilities

📊 Data Analysis & Reporting

- 

Design, build, and maintain automated dashboards (e.g., Looker Studio, Tableau) to track ticket sales, registration funnels, and marketing ROI.

- 

Monitor and analyze performance across all digital marketing channels, including paid media (Google, X/Twitter, Meta, LinkedIn), email campaigns, and organic socials.

- 

Conduct post-campaign deep dives to identify trends, evaluate channel efficiency, and provide strategic recommendations for future event cycles.

🎯 Audience Segmentation & CRM Management

- 

Manage and clean our global database of attendees, speakers, sponsors, and media partners.

- 

Develop advanced audience segmentation strategies for targeted email marketing campaigns based on historical attendance, industry verticals, and user behavior.

- 

Ensure data hygiene, compliance (GDPR, PDPA), and smooth synchronization between our event ticketing platforms, CRM, and marketing automation tools.

⚙️ Conversion Optimization & Tracking

- 

Own the setup and auditing of tracking pixels, Google Tag Manager (GTM), and GA4 to ensure flawless data attribution.

- 

Collaborate with the growth marketing team to set up A/B tests for landing pages, ad creatives, and email copy, interpreting data to improve conversion rates.

- 

Map and optimize the end-to-end user journey from initial touchpoint to ticket purchase.
